summary: Frontend-only regression on Iter 35 features: mobile training (7 items, 4 langs, video+track), offline payslip pack (save/save-all/open, Cache Storage), team punch map RBAC (admin visible, plain user hidden), desktop /attendance punch map (stats, filter, CSV, table), biometric button gating (hidden without platform authenticator), branch geofence edit (persist + cleanup), classic regression flows. All PASS. One minor observation on /vouchers dev error overlay from Axios 429s during automated test bursts.

issues: attendance-map-date is a custom shadcn calendar (DIV button) rather than a native <input type=date>, so it cannot be driven via Playwright .fill(). Not a bug (spec-compliant with shadcn), but automated tests need to open the popover and click a day. Consider adding a data-testid on the calendar body to make the empty-state past-date scenario testable.

action_items: OPTIONAL: /vouchers page fires many parallel /api requests on mount (summary, list, branches, digest prefs, etc). During rapid navigation this triggers the backend rate limiter (429) and CRA's uncaught runtime error overlay pops with a wall of AxiosErrors. Consider (a) catching AxiosErrors at the load functions instead of Promise.all rejecting, and/or (b) softening the rate limit for authenticated GETs. Only reproducible under aggressive testing but the overlay hides the UI when it does happen.

OPTIONAL: expose a testable native input alongside the shadcn calendar for attendance-map-date, or add data-testid to day buttons in the popover, so the empty-past-date branch can be exercised by Playwright.
critical_code_review_comments: MobileClock team-map section renders only when the /api/mobile/punch/team fetch succeeds — under 429 it silently hides for supervisors too. Consider showing an error/retry state instead of blank so admins don't think RBAC is broken.
Vouchers page load functions swallow individual failures into Promise.all which surfaces as an unhandled runtime overlay in dev; wrap each with .catch to keep partial UI rendering.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The /vouchers page can drop into a CRA red 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay when the backend rate-limits (429) — this is caused by rapid navigation during automated testing and is not a real functional bug. Space out UI test bursts with 60-120s sleeps when running against this preview. attendance-map-date is a shadcn calendar (DIV), not a native input; use popover clicks or a virtual date via evaluate() to test the empty state. Mobile bottom nav uses testids m-nav-* NOT mobile-nav-*.
rca_of_issues: None — all features working as specified. The 429 overlay under load is an environmental artifact of automated testing hitting the backend rate limiter, plus /vouchers doing many parallel loads. Suggested code-side softening captured in action_items above.
